text: At its meeting on May 12, 2021, the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority considered Item PA23.1, Results of Agreed-Upon Procedures to Assess Controls over Pay and Display Credit Card Revenues.
City Council on July 14, 15 and 16, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the letter (May 12, 2021) from the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority for information.
